source.prompt: House song, about 3.5 minutes, 124 BPM, G minor. Sun-drenched summer rooftop mood, euphoric and warm. Bright, soulful female lead vocal with stacked harmonies on the chorus. Chopped piano stabs, warm organ chords, rolling plucked bassline, filtered disco strings, soft synth pad. Four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hats, claps on 2 and 4, shaker. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Verse]
Heat on the stairwell, keys in my hand
Seven floors up to the place we planned
Washing lines waving, the sky turning gold
Nobody up here is ever too old

[Pre-Chorus]
Call up your sister, call up the street
Bring every summer you still want to keep

[Chorus]
It's rooftop weather, come up, come up
Nothing but heaven and a paper cup
We'll dance together till the lights give up
It's rooftop weather, come up, come up

[Verse]
Radio crackling, a song from the bay
Somebody's mother is swaying away
Pigeons are circling, the tar's getting warm
We'll laugh at the clouds if they bring on a storm

[Pre-Chorus]
Call up your sister, call up the street
Bring every summer you still want to keep

[Chorus]
It's rooftop weather, come up, come up
Nothing but heaven and a paper cup
We'll dance together till the lights give up
It's rooftop weather, come up, come up

[Bridge]
Stay where the city can't reach you
Stay where the evening is kind
Up here the whole world is smaller
Leave all the traffic behind

[Chorus]
It's rooftop weather, come up, come up
Nothing but heaven and a paper cup
We'll dance together till the lights give up
It's rooftop weather, come up, come up
